packages.name: Sonic 2 Native Widescreen (JUE REV01, ABI 2)
packages.author: segarecomp SEG-124
packages.supported_scope: Single-player running levels and attract demos of JUE REV01 with reconstructed scenery and the relocated animated HUD (the ABI 2 successor of the published ABI 1 package: same scope, same BPS delta, same verification).
limitations: Applies only to the one image this entry lists (JUE REV01); any other image is refused by digest.
Gameplay can differ slightly: additional actors become active or visible in the widened margins (the BPS delta is the ABI 1 package's).

Hill Top's lower lava background band, Wing Fortress beyond its first sections, the ending and special-stage presentation fall back to the generic renderer. Two-player mode and 240-line PAL frames are not covered.

Needs a segarecomp build with native ABI 2 minor 2 (a product revision that contains SEG-152-T003 to SEG-152-T008, pinned in scripts/PRODUCT_REF); no tagged segarecomp release can install it yet. The ABI 1 package of this image stays the published one.
